1933, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 98 Cont.
Mar. 22 Rev. Fr. McClory ... . Recovering .... Charles Warner - 8 - Scarlet Fever in Kiefer's Blank Page
Page 99
Page 100
Mar. 22 Mr. & Mrs. Buzzard - non Catholics Mrs. McPharlin - 49 - diabetic gangreen.
Al Richer - 32 - bad company, wife and chil. neglected. .. trys to keep good ... has been neglecting sacraments ....
Mrs. Hoff - 71 Pocket - b - found Mrs. Edna Kolz - 32 - Eczema of scalp
Mar. 29 Mrs. Jennie Schaefer - 40 - scrupulous - to healer - spiritist, wife a medium
Clara S. - 21 - in Lapeer - sterilization Ernst - (Mrs. Kenney's Cousin ... ) cancer Eliz Kwidzinski - 21 - 65 1bs, wasting away Kenneth Bischoff - 3 - threatened with loss of eye - Dr. wanted to take it out, prayed for 3 weeks ago, now out of danger - not entir. Mael Phanel - 53 - from Ont. - Vericose ulcers
Margaret Stone - 20 - Erysipselas - double pneumonia, and abcessed ears, etc.
Blank Page
1933, April
Page 101 Page 102 Apr. 1 Mrs. Mary Sachse - 70 - fears blindness Eliz. Hagedorn - 53 - gall-stones, operation (Dr. says) absolutely necessary. To-day enrolls, promising to work for daily Communion and to enroll souls in Purgatory specially -(30 times) if operation be a- voided-Reported Apr. 5 cured .
